displayDescription.en:
ControlNet adds spatial conditioning to a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model without discarding the original model’s learned capability. A trainable copy of the encoder is connected to a locked backbone through zero-initialized convolution layers, allowing edge maps, depth, pose, segmentation and other controls to guide generation.

The zero-convolution design starts with no disturbance to the pretrained network and gradually learns how much control information to inject.
displayDescription.zh:
ControlNet 在不丢弃原有生成能力的前提下，为预训练文生图扩散模型加入空间条件。一个可训练的编码器副本通过零初始化卷积连接到锁定主干，使边缘、深度、姿态、分割等控制信号能够引导生成。

零卷积设计在训练开始时不会扰动预训练网络，随后逐步学习应注入多少控制信息。

html.en: Text-to-image diffusion models produced strong images but gave creators limited control over exact geometry, pose or layout. ControlNet addressed this gap by adding spatial conditions to an already trained model instead of requiring a separate generator for every control type.
html.zh: 文生图扩散模型已经能够生成高质量图像，但创作者难以精确控制几何、姿态与布局。ControlNet 通过给现有预训练模型加入空间条件解决这一缺口，而不必为每种控制类型重新训练独立生成器。

html.en: The architecture locks the original diffusion encoder and creates a trainable copy that receives an edge map, depth map, pose or other condition. Zero-initialized convolutions connect the branches, so the system starts equivalent to the pretrained model and learns control signals gradually.
html.zh: 架构锁定原始扩散编码器，并创建接收边缘、深度、姿态或其他条件的可训练副本。零初始化卷积连接两个分支，使系统从等价于预训练模型的状态出发，逐步学习控制信号。

html.en: Experts generally treat ControlNet as a standard interface for controllable diffusion because it preserves a strong base model while adding reusable spatial guidance. Its influence appears across creative tools and later adapters that separate content generation from pose, depth, edges, segmentation or layout control.
html.zh: 专家通常把 ControlNet 视为可控扩散的标准接口，因为它在保留强大基础模型的同时加入可复用空间引导。它广泛影响创作工具与后续适配器，使内容生成能够与姿态、深度、边缘、分割或布局控制分离。
